records.learningTarget: Rule XI, adopted in 1934, allowed a committee to receive evidence and testimony when ordered by the Senate.
records.prior_core_status: independently supported by source in this review; R3 counted once only in core shard
records.expression: committee evidence hearings while retaining final Senate judgment

opening.speaker: player
opening.ko: 탄핵재판의 증인 심리를 위원회에 맡기는 가상 절차를 검토합니다.
opening.en: I'm reviewing a simulated arrangement delegating witness hearings in an impeachment trial.

opening.speaker: npc:0
opening.ko: 증거 수집을 맡기는 것과 최종 판단 권한을 이전하는 것은 다릅니다.
opening.en: Delegating evidence gathering differs from transferring final judgment.

opening.speaker: npc:1
opening.ko: 1934년 Rule XI가 허용한 범위에 맞게 절차를 선택하세요.
opening.en: Choose the arrangement allowed under the 1934 Rule XI.

correct.speaker: npc:1
correct.ko: 위원회 증거 심리를 허용하되 최종 상원 판단은 별도로 유지하세요.
correct.en: Allow committee evidence hearings while retaining final Senate judgment.

incorrect.speaker: npc:0
incorrect.ko: Rule XI는 위원회 증거 수집을 허용했습니다. 최종 판단을 이전한 절차를 취소하세요.
incorrect.en: Rule XI allowed committee evidence gathering. Undo the transfer of final judgment.

records.finding: Senate historical overview lines 18–22: Rule XI requires Senate order before presiding officer appoints committee; final Senate judgment retained.
records.required_wording: KO: 상원이 명령한 경우에만 의장이 위원회를 임명하여 증거와 증언을 받게 하고, 최종 판단은 상원에 남겨 두세요. EN: If the Senate so orders, the presiding officer appoints a committee to receive evidence and testimony; final judgment remains with the Senate.
records.uncertainty: Simulation not actual meeting. For P02-393 PDF screenshot failed due to 12 MB limit; statutory text corroborated by Senate rules.

records.learningTarget: The 1970 law allowed a majority of members to call meetings without chair approval.
records.prior_core_status: independently supported by source in this review; R3 counted once only in core shard
records.expression: eight or more constitutes a majority in the simulation and check the calling requirements

opening.speaker: player
opening.ko: 가상의 15인 위원회에서 위원장이 회의 소집을 거부했습니다.
opening.en: In a simulated 15-member committee the chair refuses to call a meeting.

opening.speaker: npc:0
opening.ko: 위원장 개인 권한과 위원 다수의 절차적 권한을 구분하세요.
opening.en: Distinguish the chair's authority from the procedural rights of a majority.

opening.speaker: npc:1
opening.ko: 1970년 개편이 허용한 대체 소집 경로를 적용하세요.
opening.en: Apply the alternative meeting procedure provided by the 1970 reform.

choices.ko: 소수 위원 한 명이 단독으로 회의를 소집
choices.en: one minority member may call a meeting alone
all members must unanimously call a meeting
no meeting without the chair's approval

choices.ko: 위원 과반수로 위원장 승인 없이 소집
choices.en: a majority may call a meeting without chair approval

correct.speaker: npc:1
correct.ko: 위원 8명 이상이 다수라는 가상 계산을 확인하고 소집 요건을 검토하세요.
correct.en: Verify that eight or more constitutes a majority in the simulation and check the calling requirements.

incorrect.speaker: npc:0
incorrect.ko: 위원 과반이 위원장 승인 없이 소집할 수 있습니다. 위원장만 가능하다고 한 가상 지침을 수정하세요.
incorrect.en: A majority may call a meeting without chair approval. Revise the chair-only simulated guideline.

records.finding: Public Law 91-510 §102(a), 84 Stat. 1143–44 (extracted text lines 181–191): three members submit written request; chair has three calendar days to call meeting within seven calendar days; if not, majority files written notice with date/hour and clerk notifies all.
records.required_wording: KO: 15인 위원회에서 8명은 과반입니다. 최소 3인의 서면 요청, 3일 이내 소집 결정 및 7일 이내 개최 조건 불충족, 과반의 서면 통지와 위원 전원 통지를 확인하세요. EN: Eight of fifteen is a majority. Verify the written request by at least three members, the chair's failure to call within three calendar days a meeting to be held within seven calendar days, then majority written notice and notification of all members.
records.uncertainty: Simulation not actual meeting. For P02-393 PDF screenshot failed due to 12 MB limit; statutory text corroborated by Senate rules.
